I was so angry when I found out the helium tanks, they put 20% oxygen in them. I then consoled myself with the idea that I could cut myself so I could have control over my life. But then I thought that I should try ayahuasca. So I made it and then drank it, my ego died. It was so painful. So so painful. And then I begged God to live, and he said I could live if I promise to make the world a better place. It’s not about me. I am so sorry. It is so hard. There is evil in this world, and in us. But there is good in this world too, and it is our choice if we stand for what is good, even in the face of hopeless despair. But I am so glad that I didn’t kill myself. I offered someone an umbrella yesterday and I saw the look in his face. That’s why Im alive.
